classification.difficultyReason: Construct displacement diagrams and combine journeys to calculate magnitudes and true bearings.

content.prompt: In each part, draw a diagram showing the displacement vector $\overrightarrow{AC}$. Then calculate the magnitude and direction of $\overrightarrow{AC}$. Give magnitude correct to the nearest km where necessary, and direction as a true bearing correct to the nearest degree where necessary.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Sarah drives 100 km east from A to B, and then 40 km west from B to C.

answer.worked:
Taking east as positive,
$$\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{AC}&=\overrightarrow{AB}+\overrightarrow{BC}\\&=100-40\\&=60\text{ km east}.\end{aligned}$$
The magnitude is $60\text{ km}$ and the true bearing is $090^\circ\text{T}$.

spec.description: Collinear journey with C between A and B; offset arrows distinguish the return leg and displacement.
spec.mathematics: AB is 100 km east, BC is 40 km west, AC is 60 km east.

children.label: b
children.prompt: William walks 6 km south from A to B, and then 4 km east from B to C.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}|\overrightarrow{AC}|&=\sqrt{6^2+4^2}\\&=\sqrt{52}\text{ km}\\&\approx7\text{ km}.\end{aligned}$$
Let $\theta$ be the angle east of south.
$$\begin{aligned}\tan\theta&=\frac{4}{6}\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{4}{6}\right).\end{aligned}$$
The true bearing is $180^\circ-\tan^{-1}(\frac{4}{6})\approx146^\circ\text{T}$.

spec.description: Head-to-tail south and east legs with resultant from A to C, north direction and angle east of south.
spec.mathematics: A=(0,0), B=(0,-6), C=(4,-6); displacement magnitude sqrt(52), bearing 146 degrees rounded.

children.label: c
children.prompt: A boat sails 25 km east from A to B, and then 15 km northeast from B to C.

answer.worked:
Resolve the northeast leg into east and north components.
$$\begin{aligned}E&=25+15\cos45^\circ\\&=25+\frac{15\sqrt2}{2},\\N&=15\sin45^\circ\\&=\frac{15\sqrt2}{2}.\end{aligned}$$
$$\begin{aligned}|\overrightarrow{AC}|&=\sqrt{\left(25+\frac{15\sqrt2}{2}\right)^2+\left(\frac{15\sqrt2}{2}\right)^2}\\&\approx37\text{ km}.\end{aligned}$$
The true bearing is
$$\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{25+15\sqrt2/2}{15\sqrt2/2}\right)\approx073^\circ\text{T}.$$

spec.description: East leg followed by a northeast leg, with displacement A to C and the 45-degree northeast angle.
